input.context: The runner plugin's /runner:pr-fix command currently emits a free-text Markdown fix plan for crew:builder to consume; the retry counter and circuit-breaker logic in pr-fix.ts have to regex-parse severity and category out of prose, which breaks whenever the prose wording drifts. Design a typed contract for the fix-plan payload that both the emitting CLI and the consuming builder dispatch prompt can agree on. It must be versioned so future fields (e.g. a new failure category) are additive, not breaking.
constraints: Emitting side is a Node ESM CLI script (src/scripts/pr-fix.mts)
Consuming side is a dispatch prompt string handed to crew:builder — no code on that side, so the contract must degrade to readable prose embedded in the dispatch text
Existing priorAttempts tracking field must round-trip unchanged
No breaking change to the current JSON artifact shape without a migration note

expected_output.summary: Define a FixPlanV1 Zod schema (category: enum[lint,test,review,ci,security], severity: enum, files: string[], priorAttempts: number, version: literal(1)) written to the existing artifact path; a render() function projects the typed payload into the prose block already embedded in the dispatch prompt so the consumer side needs no code change
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not require crew:builder to parse JSON directly — prose remains the wire format for the LLM consumer; does not redesign the retry/circuit-breaker state machine itself
failure_modes_named: Schema version bump without a render() branch silently drops new fields from the prose the LLM sees
Zod parse failure on a malformed prior artifact must fall back to a warn-and-continue read, not a hard crash of the CLI

dependencies_graphed.fix_plan_schema: src/scripts/lib/pr-fix/fix-plan-schema.mts — Zod schema, single source of truth
dependencies_graphed.artifact_writer: src/scripts/pr-fix.mts calls schema.parse before write; write fails closed on invalid data
dependencies_graphed.render_prose: fix-plan-schema.mts exports render(plan): string consumed by the dispatch-prompt builder

interfaces_typed.FixPlanV1: { version: 1; category: 'lint'|'test'|'review'|'ci'|'security'; severity: 'low'|'medium'|'high'; files: string[]; priorAttempts: number }

expected_output.test_strategy_present: Unit: schema.parse round-trips a v1 fixture; render() snapshot test asserts prose contains all typed fields; migration test: a v0 (untyped) artifact fixture is read and coerced with a warn log, not a throw
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: A full JSON wire format between CLI and builder was considered and rejected — the builder dispatch has no code path to parse JSON, it's an LLM reading text, so the typed schema's value is CLI-side validation + versioning discipline, not machine-to-machine parsing
